# Eagle Web Creation

> Eagle Web Creation is a web design business in Wyoming's Big Horn Basin, run by Talon Grant. It builds and manages clean, fast, custom-built websites for businesses in Lovell, Cody, Powell, Greybull, Basin, Worland, Thermopolis and the surrounding area, and larger sites for statewide and multistate businesses.

- Owner: Talon Grant. You work with him directly: no sales team and no hand-offs.
- Services: website creation, website management, website consultation
- Service area: Big Horn Basin, Wyoming (Big Horn, Park, Washakie and Hot Springs counties), plus statewide and multistate clients
- Email: talon@eaglewebcreation.com
- Phone: 307-254-8972
- Schedule a call: https://calendly.com/eaglewebcreation/30min
- Contact form: https://eaglewebcreation.com/#contact (replies within one business day)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/share/1CwFkk1u5P/
- Full text of every page: https://eaglewebcreation.com/llms-full.txt

## Services

- Website creation: a new site built around the business's services, logo and colors. Fast, made for phones, and set up so Google understands what the business does. From $800.
- Website management: once a site is live, Talon keeps it current. Clients send new hours, prices, photos or services and he handles it. From $75/month.
- Website consultation: for anyone not sure what size of site they need, or what's holding their current site back. Required for 10+ page sites.

## Pricing

Website creation is priced by the number of pages:

- 1-5 pages: $800. For local small businesses that work within about a 60-mile radius.
- 6-10 pages: $1,500. For larger businesses that advertise statewide.
- 10+ pages: priced after a consultation. For multistate businesses and online stores (e-commerce).

Every site comes with a monthly management plan:

- Starter, $75/month (required with every site): hosting and SSL certificate, regular backups, security updates, uptime checks, and 30 minutes of edits a month.
- Growth, $150/month: everything in Starter, plus Google Business Profile upkeep and review requests sent to customers.
- Local SEO, $275/month: everything in Growth, plus monthly SEO work and a monthly report on how the site is doing.
- Extra work beyond the plan: $100 per hour, billed in full hours (an extra 40 minutes is billed as 1 hour).

Add-ons (available with any site, during the build or later):

- 3D models: from $300. Interactive 3D models customers can spin and zoom, priced by how many models and how detailed.
- Scroll animation: $100. One signature animation that plays as visitors scroll.
- Additional language: $100 per page. The site in a second language, such as Spanish.
- Logo refresh and brand kit: $200. A cleaned-up logo plus the business's colors and fonts in one place.
- Seasonal refresh: $150 per refresh. Holiday or seasonal banners, specials and touches for the season.
- Web app: priced after a consultation. A custom tool built into the site, like a client login, a calculator or a dashboard.
- Priority updates: $50/month. Change requests done within 24 hours on business days.

Website consultation: every 10+ page site starts with one, and any business can book one. It covers the business, the areas it serves, what it sells and what its current website is or isn't doing, then Talon recommends a size of site and gives a price.

## How it works

1. Build: talk, plan the pages, and build the site around the business's colors, style and voice.
2. Launch: the client checks a private preview, then the domain is connected and the site goes live.
3. Get found: the site is set up so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know what the business does, with help on the Google Business Profile.
4. Ongoing care: the monthly plan keeps the site online, secure and current. Changes can be sent anytime.

## What every site includes

- Mobile-first: built for phones first
- Fast loading
- SEO written around the services the business offers
- Ready for AI search: business details marked up so Google and AI assistants can read them
- Easy navigation with simple menus
- The client's logo and colors, used the way they're meant to look
- Domain and DNS set up properly
- Custom-built, with no drag-and-drop page builders (not Wix, Squarespace or WordPress)

Features a site can include: online booking, online ordering, quote and estimate requests, photo galleries, contact forms, and click-to-call and directions.

## Recent work

- [KB Hardware & Lumber](https://kbhardwarelumber.com/): hardware store and lumber yard in Lovell, Wyoming. Live open/closed store hours, quote requests for material lists, and a page for every department.
- [Blaze Home Loans](https://blazehomeloans.com/): mortgage broker serving Wyoming, Idaho, Montana, Colorado and Florida. Loan option pages, office locations, the team, resources for Realtors, and a clear way to talk to a loan officer.
- [208 Trailer Rentals & Moving](https://208trailerrentalsandmovingllc.com/): enclosed cargo trailer rentals in the Treasure Valley, Idaho. Availability check, online reservations, gate-code pickup at any hour, trailer details, and pages for movers and real estate.
